condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Brooks Falls Platform authorized public Camera Zone","subject":"Brooks Falls + Brooks River / forest context"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: Brooks Falls Platform當下開放且依ranger／容量制度合法進入；6/15–8/15腳架禁令與可能延長限制必須遵守
condition_variants.required_conditions: 瀑布／河流場景可清楚觀察；無官方關閉
condition_variants.boosters: 柔和光線；鮭魚跳瀑或熊實際出現只作現況加分
condition_variants.penalties: 平台關閉；強降水；過度壅擠導致構圖受限

viewpoints.note: NPS explicitly classifies Brooks Falls Platform as a Scenic View/Photo Spot. B75 corrects the legacy broad Katmai weather anchor to the actual Brooks Falls area using an OSM/Mapcarta platform coordinate cross-check.
viewpoints.name: Brooks Falls Platform Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: Brooks Falls官方平台與相連合法觀景結構；不可停留在禁止攝影／通行的walkway位置。

opportunities.best_time: 官方平台可用且棕熊／鮭魚活動當下實際存在時；NPS指出7月通常最集中，但月份本身不能保證
opportunities.best_season: NPS資料顯示6月中至10月中可能有熊，7月與9月較常見；實際個體與行為仍須即時wildlife state

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Brooks Falls / Riffles authorized viewing-platform Camera Zone","subject":"brown bears fishing / interacting at Brooks River and Brooks Falls"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 指定平台當下開放且使用者依ranger制度合法進入；必須有當下可靠brown-bear activity證據；遵守50-yard規則、platform etiquette與flash/tripod限制
condition_variants.required_conditions: 棕熊實際在可合法觀察範圍內活動；無官方關閉
condition_variants.boosters: 鮭魚跳瀑／捕魚行為；柔和光線；較低等候時間
condition_variants.penalties: 熊未出現；平台關閉／容量限制；強降水；人流造成構圖困難

viewpoints.note: NPS directly documents Brooks Falls and nearby platforms for bear photography, but bear abundance varies substantially by date. B75 therefore introduces a wildlife_state + dynamic_access dependency rather than inferring bears from month.

viewpoints.geometry_note: Brooks Falls、Riffles及授權觀景平台系統；只在NPS指定位置觀察熊。
